main_text.l: Generis, Virtutum, ac eruditionis nobilitate florentissimis
DN. JOH. RODOLPHO, & DN. BERNHARDO WERDMILLERIS:
DN. JOH. RODOLPHI WERDMILLERI, Suecorum quondam, Venetorumque Colonelli, Patriae, & Confoederatorum nuper militiae Ducis, à Generali, supremi, propatris mei honoratissimi,
Filiis perdilectis, amicis & fautoribus, omni officiorum, & affectus genere prosequendis
Huncce ingenioli sui, studiique Philosophici foetum, gratitudinis, & candoris testandi ergo,

page.notes: The Greek signature "Φιλοσοφεγάσης" is a reconstruction of the printed Greek name and may contain errors. The printed date/place at the foot is too faint to read and is omitted. Faint show-through text from the reverse side (including a large title in the upper area) is excluded.
